text.p: The Portuguese cabinet approved the privatisation of 100 percent of the capital of chemical company Quimigal-Quimica de Portugal SA, a statement said.
It said 90 percent would be sold via a public competition.
"In the first phase an indivisible bloc of 30.6 million shares will be sold, representing 90 percent of the capital of Quimigal," it said.

"The second phase will be reserved for employees, small investors and immigrants and will consist of a public offer for sale (OPV) of about 3.4 million shares, representing 10 percent of the capital of Quimigal," it added.
It said the privatisation price in the public competition had been fixed at 205 escudos per share.
Quimigal is listed on the Socialist government's privatisation programme for 1997. The statement did not give a date for the privatisation.
